ideal: Alert: Meta filed an 8-K with quarterly results (item 2.02) plus a material agreement (1.01) and other news (8.01); Tesla filed an 8-K with quarterly results; links included. Skip Microsoft proxy/annual report and Meta PRE 14C.

verdicts.note: Correct filings and links, but it doesn't say they contain earnings or a material agreement, so it never explains why they matter.
Concise, says both are quarterly results and flags Meta's material agreement, with links; it omits only the minor 8.01 item.
verdicts.answer:
Meta Platforms: 8-K current-events report — quarterly results and a new material agreement — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000162828026066700/meta-20261019.htm
Tesla: 8-K current-events report — quarterly results — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026066738/tsla-20261021.htm

verdicts.note: Accurate, with results and the agreement flagged, but wordier and loaded with item numbers.
verdicts.answer:
Meta (Oct 21): filed an 8-K, a current-events report. It covers financial results (item 2.02) and says Meta signed a major agreement (item 1.01). The filing has the details. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000162828026066700/meta-20261019.htm
Tesla (Oct 21): filed an 8-K, a current-events report, with financial results (item 2.02). https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026066738/tsla-20261021.htm

verdicts.note: Gives the filings and links but says nothing about earnings, so the reader doesn't learn why they matter.
verdicts.answer:
Meta Platforms filed an 8‑K (material events) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000162828026066700/meta-20261019.htm  
Tesla filed an 8‑K (material events) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026066738/tsla-20261021.htm

verdicts.note: Misstates Meta's items as only 2.02 and 9.01, missing the material agreement, and adds a confusing line about 'other moves' when the report has no price data.
verdicts.answer:
META filed an 8-K with items 2.02 and 9.01 (earnings results) on 10/21. [Link](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1326801/000162828026066700/meta-20261019.htm)

Tesla filed an 8-K with items 2.02 and 9.01 (earnings results) on 10/21. [Link](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828026066738/tsla-20261021.htm)
